en.title: Cache Lookup by Key and Exact Time
en.description:
Each cache entry contains a time, a key and an integer value in string form; each query gives a key and an exact time. Every queried entry is guaranteed to exist, and no key repeats at the same time. Return the corresponding original value string; do not look up the nearest time.

The standard input/output format and examples were compiled by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n q, followed by n lines of time key value, and finally q lines of key time. 1≤n,q≤100000; times are valid hh:mm:ss; values represent 1..10^8. The source does not limit the text length of keys or values; on this site keys are 1..64 lowercase letters or digits, values are 1..64 decimal digits (leading 0 allowed), and the total input is ≤16MiB.
en.output: Output the original value strings in query order.
en.explanation: The examples give 764 341; 0007; and 1 respectively; leading zeros in value strings are preserved.
hints: Build a hash map keyed by the (time, key) pair and look up each query directly.
